label: AI system
definition: A machine-based system that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment, and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.
source_quote: means a machine-based system that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment, and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments;

label: provider
definition: A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops an AI system or general-purpose AI model, or has one developed, and places it on the market or puts it into service under its own name or trademark.
source_quote: means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops an AI system or a general-purpose AI model

label: deployer
definition: A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body using an AI system under its authority except where the AI system is used in the course of a personal non-professional activity.
source_quote: means a natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body using an AI system under its authority except where the AI system is used in the course of a personal non-professional activity;

label: authorised representative
definition: A natural or legal person located or established in the Union who has received and accepted a written mandate from a provider of an AI system or a general-purpose AI model to, respectively, perform and carry out on its behalf the obligations and procedures established by this Regulation.
source_quote: means a natural or legal person located or established in the Union who has received and accepted a written mandate from a provider of an AI system or a general-purpose AI model to, respectively, perform and carry out on its behalf the obligations and procedures established by this Regulation;

label: importer
definition: A natural or legal person located or established in the Union that places on the market an AI system that bears the name or trademark of a natural or legal person established in a third country.
source_quote: means a natural or legal person located or established in the Union that places on the market an AI system that bears the name or trademark of a natural or legal person established in a third country;

label: distributor
definition: A natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the provider or the importer, that makes an AI system available on the Union market.
source_quote: means a natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the provider or the importer, that makes an AI system available on the Union market;

label: operator
definition: A provider, product manufacturer, deployer, authorised representative, importer or distributor.
source_quote: means a provider, product manufacturer, deployer, authorised representative, importer or distributor;

label: downstream provider
definition: A provider of an AI system, including a general-purpose AI system, which integrates an AI model, regardless of whether the AI model is provided by themselves and vertically integrated or provided by another entity based on contractual relations.
source_quote: means a provider of an AI system, including a general-purpose AI system, which integrates an AI model, regardless of whether the AI model is provided by themselves and vertically integrated or provided by another entity based on contractual relations.

label: notifying authority
definition: The national authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring.
source_quote: means the national authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring;

label: market surveillance authority
definition: The national authority carrying out the activities and taking the measures pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
source_quote: means the national authority carrying out the activities and taking the measures pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020;

label: law enforcement authority
definition: Any public authority competent for the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including the safeguarding against and the prevention of threats to public security.
source_quote: any public authority competent for the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including the safeguarding against and the prevention of threats to public security;

label: AI Office
definition: The Commission’s function of contributing to the implementation, monitoring and supervision of AI systems and general-purpose AI models, and AI governance, provided for in Commission Decision of 24 January 2024.
source_quote: means the Commission’s function of contributing to the implementation, monitoring and supervision of AI systems and general-purpose AI models, and AI governance, provided for in Commission Decision of 24 January 2024;

label: national competent authority
definition: A notifying authority or a market surveillance authority.
source_quote: means a notifying authority or a market surveillance authority;

label: general-purpose AI model
definition: An AI model, including where such an AI model is trained with a large amount of data using self-supervision at scale, that displays significant generality and is capable of competently performing a wide range of distinct tasks regardless of the way the model is placed on the market.
source_quote: means an AI model, including where such an AI model is trained with a large amount of data using self-supervision at scale, that displays significant generality and is capable of competently performing a wide range of distinct tasks regardless of the way the model is placed on the market

label: general-purpose AI system
definition: An AI system which is based on a general-purpose AI model and which has the capability to serve a variety of purposes, both for direct use as well as for integration in other AI systems.
source_quote: means an AI system which is based on a general-purpose AI model and which has the capability to serve a variety of purposes, both for direct use as well as for integration in other AI systems;

label: emotion recognition system
definition: An AI system for the purpose of identifying or inferring emotions or intentions of natural persons on the basis of their biometric data.
source_quote: means an AI system for the purpose of identifying or inferring emotions or intentions of natural persons on the basis of their biometric data;

label: biometric categorisation system
definition: An AI system for the purpose of assigning natural persons to specific categories on the basis of their biometric data, unless it is ancillary to another commercial service and strictly necessary for objective technical reasons.
source_quote: means an AI system for the purpose of assigning natural persons to specific categories on the basis of their biometric data, unless it is ancillary to another commercial service and strictly necessary for objective technical reasons;

label: remote biometric identification system
definition: An AI system for the purpose of identifying natural persons, without their active involvement, typically at a distance through the comparison of a person’s biometric data with the biometric data contained in a reference database.
source_quote: means an AI system for the purpose of identifying natural persons, without their active involvement, typically at a distance through the comparison of a person’s biometric data with the biometric data contained in a reference database;

label: real-time remote biometric identification system
definition: A remote biometric identification system, whereby the capturing of biometric data, the comparison and the identification all occur without a significant delay, comprising not only instant identification, but also limited short delays in order to avoid circumvention.
source_quote: means a remote biometric identification system, whereby the capturing of biometric data, the comparison and the identification all occur without a significant delay, comprising not only instant identification, but also limited short delays in order to avoid circumvention;

label: post-remote biometric identification system
definition: A remote biometric identification system other than a real-time remote biometric identification system.
source_quote: means a remote biometric identification system other than a real-time remote biometric identification system;
